mentl/7fd0a6b:
One artifact read replaced the mapped build: the floor fold takes
its init as an i32 word — generic floats ride boxed words end to
end, the f64-state micro passing at 42 through word slots — and
the hstate readers are the shared arm fns, one global pair for
floor and twins alike, so the slot ABI is floor-owned words by
construction. Repr-true slots would break the shared arms. The
corrected fix is two twin-local emit arms: box a wide value at the
twin state store (8-byte cell, f64.store, pointer word — the floor
own convention) and unbox a wide result at the twin handler-result
read. Zero layout change, zero lower change, fence untouched; the
projection/threading/fence map is superseded and banked as the
repr-true-arms future. The earlier boxed-slot rejection was wrong
for this record class: 5.U repr-true fields bind records whose
readers are repr-aware, and shared floor arms are not.

mentl/7f98d7d:
The L1 blocker, dissolved by ONE edge, found by the lens (one graph, two
operations): inference flowed *calls* into the frame (infer_row_edge / inf_add_row)
but *closure-creation* flowed nothing — that asymmetry was the leak.

A closure created in fn F CAPTURES F's evidence for the effects it performs (it
reads F's frame at call time), so F's row must RECEIVE the closure's row. That is
the exact dual of the call edge. Probes proved the graph already held the truth:
the lambda's own row carries {Env2} (live), use_each's row was empty — the edge
was simply missing. So infer_walk_expr_lambda / the LambdaExpr arm now draw
`inf_add_row(open([], lambda_row))` into the enclosing frame after the lambda's
frame exits — read live, no generalize/instantiate/subst touched, no copy.

This is the graph-form, not a patch: the missing flow edge, unifying
closure-creation with calls under one mechanism. The four prior surgical attempts
regressed 200-280 sites BECAUSE they patched the copy-machinery; this adds the
structural edge the copy never had.

Verified both layers (seed + wheel mirror):

  134). The handler-free repro forward(g,v)=g(v) closes too.
- census 189 exact; battery green (ev2/ev4/ev8=57 ev5=21 ev16=18 eq=73 interp=59);
  drift-audit clean.

tokensafe/7fdc916:
Degraded tokens (e.g. TRUMP) previously scored 0/LOW when checks failed,
giving bots false confidence on incomplete analysis. Three root causes
fixed:

1. Uncertainty penalties: when checks fail even after fallbacks, apply
   honest scoring (+10 top_holders/liquidity/honeypot, +5 token_age,
   +3 metadata). Max uncertainty = 38 → MODERATE, not CRITICAL.

2. Data recovery fallbacks:
   - Top holders: Helius DAS getTokenAccounts (3 pages, 3000 accounts)
     when getTokenLargestAccounts throws "Too many accounts"
   - Liquidity: DexScreener API fallback catches CLMM-only pools,
     Jupiter timeouts/429s
   - Token age: limit 100→1000 sigs for accurate creation time

3. Lite/MCP response enriched with degraded_checks[], checks_completed,
   checks_total so agents can see what data is missing.

386 tests (was 369), all passing. No breaking schema changes.
